title: SciWrid Toolkit Normalized Refs v1
description: Sprint 1 normalized refs schema for the SciWrid Toolkit C runtime query engine. One refs file = one variable = one source dataset. The C runtime loads this file once and runs many queries against it without loading the full source data.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this spec. Increment when the schema is not backward-compatible.

source_path.description: Path to the binary data file that chunk_index offsets point into. May be absolute or relative to the refs file. For GRIB2 sources: the offline normalizer decodes to a companion .bin file and sets this to that path. For NetCDF4 sources: may point directly to the .nc file if HDF5 chunk layout is preserved.

format.description: Encoding of raw chunk bytes in source_path. raw_f32le: IEEE 754 float32 little-endian, no compression. zlib_f32le: zlib-compressed IEEE 754 float32 little-endian. The C runtime uses this to select the chunk decoder.

variable.description: Metadata for the one variable stored in this refs file.

name.description: Variable name as it appears in the source dataset (e.g. '2t', 'temperature_2m', 'TMP').

dtype.description: Data type of decoded values. Sprint 1 runtime supports f32le only.

shape.description: Full dataset shape as [nt, nlat, nlon]. Must match the length of coordinate arrays.

chunks.description: Chunk shape as [ct, clat, clon]. Sprint 1: always [1, nlat, nlon] — one full spatial grid per time step. Sub-spatial chunks are deferred to later sprints.

compression.description: Compression applied to each chunk in source_path. 'none' = raw float32 bytes. 'zlib' = zlib-deflate compressed float32 bytes. The C runtime links -lz when zlib is used.

fill_value.description: Sentinel value used to mark missing or masked data points. The query engine replaces fill_value with NaN before returning results.

units.description: Physical units of the variable (e.g. 'K', 'm s**-1', 'kg m**-2').

dimensions.description: Ordered dimension names. Sprint 1 requires exactly ['time', 'lat', 'lon'].

coordinates.description: Coordinate arrays stored inline as base64-encoded little-endian binary. Kept small enough to decode entirely at session startup.

time.description: Time axis. dtype must be i64. Values are Unix timestamps in seconds (integer). Length must equal shape[0].

lat.description: Latitude axis in degrees north, monotonically increasing or decreasing. dtype must be f32. Length must equal shape[1].

lon.description: Longitude axis in degrees east, monotonically increasing. dtype must be f32. Values may span [0, 360) or [-180, 180). Length must equal shape[2].

chunk_index.description: Map from chunk key to byte range in source_path. Keys use the format 'ti.lati.loni' where ti is the time-chunk index, lati the lat-chunk index, loni the lon-chunk index. In Sprint 1 (chunks=[1,nlat,nlon]), keys are '0.0.0', '1.0.0', ..., '{nt-1}.0.0'.

dtype.description: Little-endian element type of the coordinate array.

values_inline_base64.description: Base64-encoded raw little-endian bytes of the coordinate array. Decode length must equal the corresponding shape dimension * sizeof(dtype).

offset.description: Byte offset from the start of source_path to the beginning of this chunk.

length.description: Number of bytes to read for this chunk starting at offset. For compression=none: length = clat * clon * sizeof(dtype). For compression=zlib: length is the compressed size.
